name: Faena Hotel Miami Beach
insider_take: Where Argentine glamour meets Miami Beach sophistication in a theatrical oceanfront masterpiece
whats_special: This Philippe Starck-designed hotel occupies the historic Saxony Hotel building from 1948, transformed into a crimson-hued fantasy with gold accents throughout. The property features original murals by Argentine artist Juan Gatti and houses the exclusive Faena Theater, hosting world-class cabaret performances. Each suite boasts floor-to-ceiling windows with direct ocean views, while the rooftop offers one of South Beach's most coveted party destinations.
pro_tip: Book the Penthouse Ocean Front suite for access to the exclusive rooftop terrace, and don't miss the complimentary beach butler service with Hermès beach accessories.
dont_miss: The Saturday night performances at Faena Theater featuring international cabaret acts, and dinner at Los Fuegos by Francis Mallmann, the hotel's acclaimed Argentine steakhouse. The Tierra Santa Healing House spa offers unique South American-inspired treatments you won't find elsewhere in Miami Beach.
pros: Dramatic theatrical design by Philippe Starck with gold leaf and red velvet interiors
Direct beachfront location on pristine Miami Beach sand
World-class spa and wellness facilities with innovative treatments
Multiple acclaimed dining venues including signature restaurants
cons: Bold artistic design may not appeal to traditional tastes
